arxiv-1904-11991.title: Building the Evryscope: Hardware Design and Performance
arxiv-1904-11991.creator: Jeffrey K. Ratzloff, Nicholas M. Law, Octavi Fors, Henry T. Corbett, Ward S. Howard, Daniel del Ser, Joshua Haislip
arxiv-1904-11991.description: Abstract The Evryscope is a telescope array designed to open a new parameter space in optical astronomy, detecting short timescale events across extremely large sky areas simultaneously. The system consists of a 780 MPix 22-camera array with an 8150 sq. deg.

arxiv-2012-01843.title: Stochastic Adversarial Gradient Embedding for Active Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2012-01843.creator: Victor Bouvier, Philippe Very, Clément Chastagnol, Myriam Tami, Céline Hudelot
arxiv-2012-01843.description: Abstract Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) aims to bridge the gap between a source domain, where labelled data are available, and a target domain only represented with unlabelled data. If domain invariant representations have dramatically improved the adaptability of models, to guarantee their good transferability remains a challenging problem.

arxiv-2110-01893.title: Validation scheme for solar coronal models - constraints from multi-perspective observations in EUV and white-light
arxiv-2110-01893.creator: A. Wagner, E. Asvestari ,, M. Temmer, S.G. Heinemann, J. Pomoell
arxiv-2110-01893.description: Abstract Context. In this paper we present a validation scheme to investigate the quality of coronal magnetic field models, which is based upon comparisons with observational data from multiple sources. Aims. Many of these coronal models may use a range of initial parameters that produce a large number of physically reasonable field configurations.

arxiv-2402-07598.title: Near-Minimax-Optimal Distributional Reinforcement Learning with a Generative Model Thanks: Correspondence to markrowland@google.com . Thanks: Work done while at Google DeepMind.
arxiv-2402-07598.creator: Mark Rowland, Li Kevin Wenliang, Rémi Munos, Clare Lyle, Yunhao Tang, Will Dabney
arxiv-2402-07598.description: Abstract We propose a new algorithm for model-based distributional reinforcement learning (RL), and prove that it is minimax-optimal for approximating return distributions in the generative model regime (up to logarithmic factors), the first result of this kind for any distributional RL algorithm.

arxiv-2411-04340.title: Survival of the Notable: Gender Asymmetry in Wikipedia Collective Deliberations
arxiv-2411-04340.creator: Khandaker Tasnim Huq, Giovanni Luca Ciampaglia
arxiv-2411-04340.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Khandaker Tasnim Huq, Giovanni Luca Ciampaglia. Communities on the web rely on open conversation forums for a number of tasks, including governance, information sharing, and decision making. However these forms of collective deliberation can often result in biased outcomes. A prime example are Articles for Deletion (AfD) discussions on Wikipedia, which allow editors to gauge the notability of existing articles, and that, as prior work has suggested, may play a role in perpetuating the notorious gender gap of Wikipedia.

pmc-12366060.title: Effects of temperature and nutrition stress on Anopheles stephensi, an Indian urban malaria vector
pmc-12366060.creator: Chaitali Ghosh, Naveen Kumar, Soumya Mogaveerthi, Sanjay Lamba, Chethan Kumar Ramanjini, Soumya Gopal Joshi, Priyanka Chandran, Sampath Kumar, Sunita Swain
pmc-12366060.description: BackgroundChanging climate and complexity in ecological landscape can potentially expand the geographic distribution of mosquitoes (Diptera: Culicidae) to adapt and transmit various vector-borne diseases, including malaria. Anopheles stephensi is a potential urban malaria vector in the Indian subcontinent. Temperature and nutrients are the important environmental stressors, which influence the life cycle and vectorial competence of mosquitoes.

pmc-12428250.title: The Impact of Different Dietary Patterns on Mortality and Prognosis After Non-Metastatic Prostate Cancer Diagnosis: A Systematic Review
pmc-12428250.creator: Thaw Htet, Florence Cheng, Uhjin Yang, Athulya Harikrishna, Veronica Preda, Juliana Chen, Carlos Ruiz-Moreno, Clara Benna
pmc-12428250.description: Objective: The aim of this systematic review was to compare the impact of various dietary patterns on cancer mortality, recurrence, remission, quality of life, and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) in non-metastatic prostate cancer patients. Methods: Ovid Medline, EMBASE, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), and Scopus databaseswere searched from inception to March 2024.

pmc-12561760.title: Ability of Surface Electrocardiography in Predicting Ventricular Arrhythmias in Dogs with Secondary Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-12561760.creator: Giovanni Romito, Chiara Mazzoldi, Carlotta Valente, Helen Poser, Giulia Arcuri, Barbara Contiero, Carlo Guglielmini
pmc-12561760.description: Simple SummaryAtrial fibrillation (AF) and ventricular arrhythmias (VAs) are the most common pathological arrhythmias of dogs and are associated with a poor prognosis in those with cardiac disease. While several studies have investigated the clinical features of AF and VAs individually, few have documented their concurrent occurrence.

pmc-12973792.title: Clinical characteristics and preliminary retrospective evidence of adjunctive efficacy of intense pulsed light therapy for Demodex-associated blepharokeratoconjunctivitis: a single-center study
pmc-12973792.creator: Shuo Yang, Ning Wang, Qingli Meng, Lin Lin, Lijuan Wang, Xiuming Jin
pmc-12973792.description: ObjectiveTo characterize clinical features of Demodex blepharokeratoconjunctivitis (BKC) and evaluate the efficacy of intense pulsed light (IPL) adjunctive therapy.MethodsRetrospective cohort study of 45 microbiologically confirmed Demodex-BKC patients. Outcomes were compared between conventional treatment (n = 35) and IPL-adjunctive groups (n = 10).ResultsCorneal lesions predominantly involved the inferior cornea, with characteristic lid margin signs including cylindrical dandruff and recurrent chalazia.

pmc-13012957.title: The stories of the ageing population in Luton, United Kingdom on their experience of periodontal diseases healthcare
pmc-13012957.creator: Karuna Preethi Velpula, Enemona Jacob
pmc-13012957.description: BackgroundOral health is an important part of general wellbeing, but in the United Kingdom there are substantive inequalities, especially based on ethnic minority and ageing. There is a poor quality of life, a lack of awareness and preventive measures, and periodontal disease contributes to loss of teeth, poor nutrition, and poor quality of life.

pmc-13096539.title: Multi-representation thermal features for enhanced defect analysis in pulse thermography
pmc-13096539.creator: Mohammed Salah, Naoufel Werghi, Davor Svetinovic, Stefano Sfarra, Yusra Abdulrahman
pmc-13096539.description: AI-driven pulse thermography (PT) has become a crucial tool in non-destructive testing (NDT), enabling automatic detection of hidden anomalies in various industrial components. Current state-of-the-art PT segmentation and depth estimation networks rely on thermal features extracted from Principal Component Thermography (PCT) or Thermographic Signal Reconstruction (TSR) representations.

pmc-13239879.title: Curated set of tool compounds to probe PYK2 and FAK signaling in Alzheimer's disease
pmc-13239879.creator: Pathum M Weerawarna, Cynthia D Jesudason, Karen L Lobb, Emily R Mason, Xiaoping Gu, Shaoyou Chu, Timothy I Richardson
pmc-13239879.description: INTRODUCTIONProline‐rich tyrosine kinase 2 (PYK2) and focal adhesion kinase (FAK) are non‐receptor tyrosine kinases implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD), but their functional role in microglia remains understudied. Selective pharmacological tools are required for preclinical studies leading to translational therapeutic development.

pmc-13287913.title: Predictors of Green Behavior Among Hospital Nurses: Organizational Climate, Team Climate, and Awareness of Consequences
pmc-13287913.creator: Seung Eun Lee, Heejin Lim, Sujin Nam, V. Susan Dahinten
pmc-13287913.description: AimThis study aimed to examine the relationship between nurses’ perceptions of the green organizational climate, perceptions of green team climate, and awareness of consequences, are related to their green behavior in hospitals.BackgroundHealthcare is a resource‐intensive sector where everyday employee green behavior can meaningfully reduce environmental impacts.

pmc-13348047.title: Sensor-derived multidimensional gait domains mediate the association between intrinsic capacity impairment and fall risk in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13348047.creator: Siyu Chen, Ji Shen, Yuting Kang, Yushan Zhang, Hong Shi, Chi Zhang, Jie Zhang
pmc-13348047.description: BackgroundFalls are a leading cause of injury and functional decline in older adults. Intrinsic capacity (IC) impairment has emerged as an important predictor of fall risk, yet the biomechanical pathways linking IC decline to falls remain uncharacterized. Whether sensor-derived multidimensional gait domains serve as domain-specific indirect pathways in the IC-fall association has not been examined.

pmc-13480240.title: Secondary Cardiac Lymphoma Presenting as Effusive–Constrictive Pericarditis
pmc-13480240.creator: Amelia Tochtrop, Azalfa Lateef, Will Mai, Jay Schneider, Mays Ali
pmc-13480240.description: BackgroundDiffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) may present as effusive constrictive pericarditis.Case SummaryA 40-year-old woman with relapsed high-grade DLBCL presented with worsening dyspnea and acute decompensated heart failure. Two weeks prior, she underwent a pericardial window with preserved left ventricular ejection fraction of 50%.

uslaw-usc-t49-s44715.title: 49 U.S.C. § 44715 — Controlling aircraft noise and sonic boom
uslaw-usc-t49-s44715.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s44715.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Air Commerce And Safety); Subpart iii (Safety); Chapter 447 (Safety Regulation). (a) Standards and Regulations.— (1) (A) To relieve and protect the public health and welfare from aircraft noise and sonic boom, the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration, as he deems necessary, shall prescribe— (i) standards to measure.
